༄༅/ /bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma'i glang po'i cho ga bzang ngan brtag pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma'i glang po'i cho ga bzang ngan brtag pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag byas te/ de nyid kyi sgo nas glang po'i cho ga bzang ngan gyi pra brtag pa ni/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i tshes gsum brgyad bco lnga gang rung la snga dro'i dus su/ rin po che'i snod du sman dang rin po che sna tshogs dang shel dkar gyi phye ma shing thog sna tshogs 'bras dkar gyi phye ma dang bsres la/ glang po che'i gzugs shin tu mdzes pa dkar po bal sngon po'i mjug ma gyen du dril ba/ rin po che'i sga steng na nor bus spras pa nywa cung zad 'khyil ba spyi bor nor bus mtshan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i mdun du gtso mo'i bshos bu dang*/ phyogs bzhir 'khor gyi bshos bu bzhi/ mjug ma'i thad du tshe ring mched lnga'i gtor ma bshos bu rtse lnga pa gcig bzhag /gzhan yang zas sna 'bru sna tshogs par bran la/ gzhi ma dkar po'i steng du nas kyi g.yu drung bris pa'i steng kha shar du bstan la bzhag /mdun du mchod pa sna tshogs pa bshams/ a phyi'i mchod gtor logs su bshams/ mda' dar kha dog lnga ldan me long gis spras pa dang ba dan sogs bshams/ bsang dang phye mar sogs slar nyer brdog byas la/ sgrub pa po kha shar du phyogs pas phrin las myur mgyogs dang lhub gsol sngon du btang la/ glang po che bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i glang po che'i gzugs gangs ri ltar brjid ldan lhun chags pa/ rin po che'i sga srab kyis spras pa'i steng du dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu dang nyi zlas brgyan pa/ spyi bor rang rtags kyi nor bu dang bcas pa/ 'dod dgu'i dgyes pa thams cad bskyed nus pa/ gzhan yang rin po che dang*/ dmar ljang rtse lce lnga bskyod pa'i rgod chen gyi sgro dang bcas pa'i mda' dar/ dngul dkar gyi me long*/

mchod pa'i bye brag dkor nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ nam mkha'i khams kun tu gang ba dang*/ lha dang mi'i zhal zas phun sum tshogs pa/ bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed nus pa'i chos bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ rol mo dang bcas pas 'di skad do// hūm̐ */ nam mkha' mthing bzang g.yu 'od 'bar ba'i klong*// mu men mthing gi g.yu brag gter sgrom nas// che zhes chen mo a phyi sna nam bza'// dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol// dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo chos kyi sgron// sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma| |bdud bzhi'i gdan la zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs// dar dkar na bza' bdud rigs zil gyis gnon// zhi ba'i mdzum mdangs rin chen rgyan gyis spras// srid pa gsum gsal dngul dkar me long g.yas// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu g.yon na 'dzin// mthu stobs thogs med a phyi chos kyi sgron// o rgyan gnas dang dam tshig gzhal yas nas// rin chen mdzes pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// spyan 'dren mchod phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dpal ldan lha mo gtsug na nor bu ni// sku mdog dkar ser ḍā ru thod pa bsnams// zhabs gnyis mnyam bzhengs dar dang rin chen brgyan// o rgyan yul nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// dpal ldan lha mo padma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug lcags kyu 'dzin// dbang gi ngang tshul padma'i gdan la bzhugs// gnas 'dir mchod phyir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// dpal ldan lha mo yid bzhin nor bu ni// sku mdog dkar dmar ne'u rkyal nor bu 'dzin// dar dkar gyis brgyan padma'i gdan la bzhugs// dam tshig gnas nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro chen mo ni// mthing nag g.yas g.yon ral gri thod khrag 'dzin// dur khrod chas brgyan zhabs gnyis pus btsugs bzhugs// dgra bgegs tshar gcod gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs| |gangs dkar shel gyi gzhal yas dam pa nas// bkra shis tshe yi dbang phyug thugs dam can// mthing gi zhal bzang mi g.yo blo bzang ma// cod pan mgrin bzang gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma// 'khor bcas thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs shig

/rang rang mthun pa'i gdan la dgyes par bzhugs// hrīḥ dbyings phyug lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la// mthun pa'i rten mchod dam pa 'bul ba ni// bsod nams stobs bskyed glang po dam pa'i mchog /za 'og dar gdan gser gyi sga steng du// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu rgyan dang ldan| |chos kun ma 'dres snang ba'i bzhin bzhes pa// dngul dkar me long srid gsum gsal ba dang*// ma rig las skyes nyes gsum 'joms pa yi// gnyen po rang rig ye shes bzang po drug /kha dog lnga ldan dar gyi cod pan 'phan// rgod chen sgro ldan 'bigs byed mtshon la sgron// ma rig rkyen bsang dud 'thul sprin ltar 'thibs// gser g.yu rta khrab mthun pa'i rdzas dang bcas// lha mi'i zhal zas longs spyod du mar bcas// dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma 'khor bcas la// dgyes pa bskyed phyir phyi nang gsang ba yi// rten du 'bul gyis bzhes nas rtag bzhugs te// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi// bsam pa'i don kun myur du 'grub par mdzod// hrīḥ rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i yang sprul ma// o rgyan gnas byon a phyi chos kyi sgron// zhi ba'i 'dzum ldan rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas thugs dam bskang*// yon chab me tog bdug spos sna tshogs dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag med dang*// gtor ma 'bru bcud sna lngas brgyan// mda' dar stag ras me long gser g.yus brgyan// legs par btsugs nas gser skyems bdud rtsis bran// 'dod yon longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*// rta sngon rin chen sga srab brgyan pa dang*// dkor mdzod nor dang stobs chen glang po che// dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bus brgyan pa yi// dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang*// dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /tshe yi dbang phyug thugs dam bskang*| |mthing gi zhal bzang thugs dam bskang*// mi g.yo blo bzang thugs dam bskang*// cod pan mgrin bzang thugs dam bskang*// gtad dkar 'gro bzang thugs dam bskang*//

khyod rnams thugs dam bskangs gyur nas// skong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// rin chen tshe dang rma g.yang zas// mi bzad nor dang rkang bzhi pra// dngos grub rnam lnga stsal du gsol// mkha' 'gro'i longs spyod bdag la stsol// mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// bka' yi 'khor du gtogs pa yi// ma sring rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// btsan gyi rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// bdud kyi rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// gshin rje rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*| |sman gyi rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// 'brog srin rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// klu yi rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// ri yi rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// sha za mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*// ma sangs rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// khams gyi rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang*// bka' srung brtan ma'i thugs dam bskang*// khyed rnams thugs dam bskangs gyur nas// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// sgrub pa'i bar gcod sel ba dang*// dngos grub rnam gnyis ster ba dang*// phyi yi snang ba dbang du bsdus// phrin las stobs kyis bstan pa spel// tshe ring dpal bskyed 'khor rnams srungs// bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol// legs nyes bden rdzun zhal lce chod// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces brjod/ de nas bsang la phye mar bdud rtsi bran la/ kyai */ de ring gnam lo rgyal po yi// dus tshod bzang shing gza' skar dge// sangs rgyas byin che dgra bcom rnams// zag pa zad pa'i smon lam can// de tshe bdag gi don yang grub// de ring lha la bsang mchod 'bul// 'dre dang gdon rnams rang gnas dengs// dbyings phyug lha mo 'khor bcas la// sa srung glang chen dam pa'i mchog /dkor nor dpag med rten du 'bul// bzang ngan shes pa'i grangs mkhan mdzod// kyai/

nyon mongs sel ba'i sman mchog sna tshogs dang*// dar zab rin chen spos dang a ka ru// tsandan dkar dmar dri bzang du ru ka /shug pa da li stag pa la sogs te// shing sna bdud rtsi'i tshogs bcas thams cad kyi// dud 'thul sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i bsang mchod 'dis// skyabs gnas bla med dkon mchog rnam gsum bsangs// yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bsangs// bka' srung lha dang drang srong rgyud bcas bsangs// dbyings phyug ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas bsangs// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi// 'go ba'i lha dang rgyud srung lha tshogs bsangs// bdag la gnod pa'i phyogs kun sbyang phyir bsangs// gson gshin grib dang gdon nad mtshon nad bsangs// yi dang 'brum gag tshad gzer zhi phyir bsangs// dmu gab mi shes mgo 'khor mya ngan bsangs// mdor na mi mthun 'gal rkyen thams cad bsangs// de ltar bsang khrus cho ga'i rim pa yis// bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun zhi gyur nas// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces brjod/ glang po la chas bran la/ hrīḥ de ring dgra lha'i dbu 'phang bstod// chos kyi sgrol ma'i dbu 'phang bstod// sa srung rab brtan glang po'i mchog /dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig /de la dar gdan gser sga bstad// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// steng du yid bzhin nor bu bkal// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do| |srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig /g.yu mdog baiḍūrya lta bu// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig /glang sna dga' ba 'khyil ba'i dbyibs// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig /spyi gtsug nor bu 'bar bas brgyan// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig /mjug ma bar snang khams su bskyod// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig

/dar sman 'bru dang gser skyems bran// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig |mda' dar lnga ldan 'phur zhing bskyod// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig /gsal dwangs dngul dkar me long mchog /dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig /dri zhim bsang dud bar snang bsnyegs// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig /me tog la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig /phye mar bza' btung longs spyod tshogs// dharma tā ra dpang bstod do// srung ma mi dang ma 'bral zhig /ces brjod do// glang chen gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod kyi nang du glang po'i mchog sa srung chen po nor bu dam pa'i rgyan dang ldan zhing lha mi'i longs spyod du ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas brgyan pa 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma mched lnga/ tshe ring ma 'khor brtan ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag cag la dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba dang bzang ba dang ngan pa'i 'bras bu gzod gang byung ba rnams da lta nyid du bstan du gsol/ sngar gyi dam tshig gnyan po dran zhing dgongs par mdzod la mtshan ma bstan pa rnams mi shes shing*/ mi mthong*/ mi go bar mi 'gyur bar gsal dwangs rnyog pa dang bral ba'i rang mdangs da lta smra shes shing don myur du go bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes rang rang gi don sogs smod gang dgos 'dir smod la bden pa brdar zhing*/ don drag tu bsam la srung ma la gsol ba btab bo// don/ srog /mgron/ dgra srog /tshong sogs gyi cha bzang ngan smod dgos gang yod 'dir legs par smod do// de nas glang po btegs la chu chang bran te/ hrīḥ rang bzhin chos dbyings khyab gdal chen po'i klong*// sna tshogs rang mdangs 'gag med shar ba'i dpal// chos kyi sgrol ma'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la// stobs bzang glang po khyu mchog dkor nor rten// gser g.yu 'bru sman dar zab rgyan dang bcas// dgos dgu'i longs spyod tshogs dang bcas te 'bul// bdag gi bsam don 'bad med 'grub pa dang*// bdag la dge dang mi dge ci byung yang*// nad mtshon dug rims gnod pa bsrung ba dang*// bzang ngan gsal ba'i pra rtags dus 'dir ston// bdag la srung ma khyed ni thugs dgyes la/

lus grib ji bzhin rtag tu 'grogs pa dang*// bdag gi tshe dang longs spyod bsam pa'i tshogs// dbyar dus mtsho ltar ches cher rgyas pa dang*// bstan la sdang ba'i tshogs rnams thal bar rlogs// sngon tshe rigs lnga mkha' 'gro nas bzung ste// padma 'byung gnas rigs sras mched bzhi dang*// skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po nas// deng nas bzhugs pa'i mnyam med bla ma'i bar// rdo rje'i tshig gis sgrol ba'i dam tshig tshogs// ma g.yel ma khyod thugs dam dran mdzod la// bdag cag slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// gces pa'i bu la g.yel med bskyang du gsol// ma bu'i dam tshig bzhin du dran mdzod la// bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod| |de nas glang po che de sa gtsang sar phul te bya rog sogs la zar bcug pas bzang ngan ni/ steng gi nor bu zos na srog 'tsho dgra mi yong*/ grogs dang tshong legs/ don 'grub shin tu bzang yang khug par dka' lha'i chad pa yod/ spyi gtsug gi nor bu zos na tshe srog 'tsho dgra mi 'ong*/ tshong legs/ don 'grub kun la bzang*/ mig g.yas zos na srog 'tsho/ grogs mi 'ong*/ gzhan bzang*/ mig g.yon zos na don mi 'grub/ srog 'tsho/ sna zhags zos na srog 'tsho/ dmag jag las la 'gro na shin tu bzang*/ mchu ya mchu zos na don mi 'grub/ gzhan 'bring*/ lce zos na kha mchu 'ong*/ gzhan 'bring*/ ma mchu zos na mi kha 'ong*/ gzhan bzang*/ lag pa g.yas zos na lam du 'jug na shin tu bzang*/ gzhan ngan/ lag pa g.yon zos na lam du rkun ma 'ong*/ gzhan 'bring*/ sog pa g.yas zos na srog 'tsho/ gzhan ngan/ sog pa g.yon zos na tshong legs/ gzhan 'bring*/ tshang ra g.yas zos na dgra mi 'ong*/ grogs 'ong*/ gzhan 'bring stod/ tshang ra g.yon zos na jag rkun la 'gro na bzang*/ gzhan ngan/ mjug ma zos na shin tu ngan te zlog pas log thub cing gzhan ngan/ rkub zos na shin tu log /de srog mi 'tsho/

dgra 'ong grogs mi 'ong*/ tshong nyes don mi 'grub than dang ltas ngan thams cad 'ong*/ zlog pas kyang mi log pa yin no// gzhan yang grogs phywa la mig g.yas bzang*/ gzhan rnams 'bring*/ rkub dang mjug ma shin tu ngan/ dgra phywa la sna zhags bzang*/ gzhan rnams 'bring*/ gruu mo ngan/ grogs phywa la tshang ra g.yas bzang*/ gzhan rnams 'bring*/ mig gnyis ngan/ tshong phywa la spyi bo'i nor bu dang sog pa g.yon bzang*/ rkang lag dang sog pa g.yas 'bring*/ gzhan ngan/ don phywa la rgal steng dang spyi bo'i nor bu bzang*/ kha sna mig rna ba rnams 'bring*/ gzhan ngan/ mgron phywa la lag pa gnyis bzang*/ gzhan rnams 'bring*/ tshang ra g.yas g.yon ngan/ lam phywa g.yang rkang pa gnyis dang*/ sna zhags bzang*/ gzhan rnams 'bring*/ gru mo dang nor bu gnyis ngan/ srid phywal rkub dang mtshan ma bzang*/ gzhan 'bring*/ na ngan/ gzhan yang lus po'i stod smad dang bstun pa'i gong gi rigs 'gres te don 'bras dang bstun pa'i rig pas legs par dpyad la kha dmar ba dgos/ bya rog rten zar mi 'ong na rnal 'byor par 'tshe ba sogs shin tu ngan/ zhad nas bros na bskang bshags bya gtsang sbra la 'bad/ glang po mi za ba sngon la gtor ma za na/ da dung bskyar nas gtong*/ 'di rnams thams cad sngon la thog mar mchu gang du rgyab kho na brtag pa yin/ grib dang mi gtsang ba kun la 'dzem gtsang sbra cher byas la zhib tu lag len ma nor na/ don bzang ngan sogs 'khrul med 'byung gi srung ma 'dis bslu bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhib pa mthong ba brgyud pa las shes shing lag len sogs bla ma'i zhal las shes so// zhes glang po'i cho ga bzang ngan brtag pa'i thabs 'di'ang*/ skyob pas mdzad pa dang*/ dpe ka dbang rgyal dang*/ nyer brgyad pas mdzad pa rnams cung zad go dka' zhing 'thor ba zhig 'dug par brten/ phyi rabs pa 'ga' zhig gi don du shākya'i dge slong dharma kīrtis rab sgang bzhag ra lha rtse'i gangs 'dabs su sbyar ba'o//
